description: Covered/crusted liquid manure CH4. Holos code is consistent with its manual and with IPCC 2006/2019 Table 10.17: cover factors are REDUCTION fractions (crust 0.40, solid cover 0.25 only), applied as remaining = 1 - reduction. The fork difference versus source_correct is only that Holos's covered path is an MCF-free daily VS-consumed tank model (approximated here as uncovered IPCC MCF times remaining). It is not a reduction/retention mix-up. source_correct uses Table 10.17 MCF including liquid-with-crust (the ~40% crust reduction is already in that MCF). holos_as_coded never stacks the IPCC with-crust MCF on the Holos remaining factor.

options.source_correct: IPCC 2006 Vol 4 Ch 10 Table 10.17 p. 10.44/10.52 and IPCC 2019 Table 10.17 (Updated): distinct MCF by system; with-crust MCF already embeds ~40% CH4 reduction vs uncovered
options.holos_as_coded: Holos AnimalResultsServiceBase.cs:967-972 reductionFactor=0.4 (LiquidWithNaturalCrust) else 0.25 (LiquidWithSolidCover only; ManureStateTypeExtensions.cs:53-56). Lines 1279-1283 return manureMethane * (1 - emissionReductionFactor). Remaining 0.60 crust / 0.75 solid cover. Covered path is MCF-free; this fork uses uncovered MCF * remaining and does not apply 0.25 to non-solid covers.
